measures.title: Ogemaw County Road Millage
measures.summary: Would let Ogemaw County levy up to 1 mill ($1.00 per $1,000 of taxable value) on all taxable property in the county for five years, 2026 through 2030, only for local and primary road and bridge maintenance and repair in the townships, the City of West Branch, the City of Rose City and the Village of Prescott. If levied in full it would raise an estimated $1,238,997 in the first year, paid to the County Road Commission and those cities and village; part may go to the West Branch city and township downtown development authorities.
measures.yesMeans: Ogemaw County could levy up to 1 mill for road and bridge maintenance from 2026 through 2030.
measures.noMeans: Ogemaw County could not levy this road millage.

measures.title: Children Assessment Services Millage
measures.summary: Would raise Ogemaw County's property tax limit by up to 0.05 mill ($0.05 per $1,000 of taxable value) for five years, 2026 through 2030. The money would provide trauma therapy, medical care, forensic interviews, family advocacy and prevention services for county residents who have experienced physical abuse, sexual abuse or neglect. If levied in full it would raise an estimated $61,949 in the first year; part may go to the West Branch city and township downtown development authorities.
measures.yesMeans: Ogemaw County could levy up to 0.05 mill for children's assessment services from 2026 through 2030.
measures.noMeans: Ogemaw County could not levy this millage.
